description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for marine microbial genomic sequencing collected across oceanic regions and environmental gradients.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sampling record or sequenced marine microbial sample.

latitude.descr: Geographic latitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84), range -90 to 90.

longitude.descr: Geographic longitude of the sampling site in decimal degrees (WGS84), range -180 to 180.

sampling_depth_m.descr: Depth at which the sample was collected, in meters below sea surface.

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature at the time and depth of sampling, in degrees Celsius (°C).

biome_type.descr: Broad biome or habitat category of the sampling location, for example 'coral reef', 'open ocean', 'coastal water', 'deep sea', or 'estuary'.

environmental_feature.descr: Specific environmental context or feature associated with the site, such as 'near hydrothermal vent', 'upwelling zone', 'reef slope', or 'oxygen minimum zone'.

sampling_date.descr: Date when the sample was collected, recorded in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD if available.

region_name.descr: Name of the oceanic region or subregion where the sample was collected, for example 'North Atlantic', 'South Pacific', or 'Indian Ocean'.

salinity_psu.descr: Optional in situ salinity at the sampling location, in practical salinity units (PSU).

ph.descr: Optional in situ pH of the sampled water column at the collection depth.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Optional dissolved oxygen concentration at the sampling depth, in mg/L.

collection_method.descr: Method used to collect the sample, such as Niskin bottle, plankton tow, pump filtration, or sediment trap if applicable.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing technology used for the microbial genomic data, for example Illumina, PacBio, or Oxford Nanopore.

taxonomic_target.descr: Targeted genomic material or assay type, such as metagenome, 16S rRNA amplicon, or metatranscriptome.
